Politics · India

AAP Launches National Campaign Against E20 Fuel Policy

The Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) will commence a national campaign on August 1 against the E20 (20% ethanol blended petrol) policy. Party leader Arvind Kejriwal has called a 'National Town Hall' meeting at the Constitution Club. Separately, activist Tehseen Poonawala will begin a hunger strike after a silent march to Gandhi Smriti.
